sloka: ध्रियमाणं शिरोभिस्तु नागैरमितविक्रमैः ।दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दिव्यरत्नविभूषितैः ।। ७.९७.१९ ॥
transliteration: dhriyamāṇaṁ śirobhistu nāgairamitavikramaiḥ ।divyaṁ divyena vapuṣā divyaratnavibhūṣitaiḥ ।। 7.97.19 ॥

translations.english: This divine throne was being held by the heads of Nagas of immeasurable valor, who themselves possessed divine bodies adorned with divine jewels.
